retrievalProfile.description: A central hourglass silhouette containing a landscape with running figures, framed by circular typography on a textured purple background.
triggerTerms: figures running inside a glass shape

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, vertically oriented hourglass shape acts as a window into a different scene. The top bulb of the hourglass is translucent blue-green glass, while the bottom bulb contains a bright, sandy landscape with four silhouetted figures running from left to right. The entire composition is set against a deep purple, textured background with a heavy vignette and circular text framing the central object.
coreVisualRelationships: Hourglass as a container for a secondary landscape scene
Circular text path echoing the curves of the hourglass
High contrast between the bright interior scene and dark purple exterior
Horizontal movement of figures against the verticality of the hourglass
coreInvariants: Running figures in the bottom bulb

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The hourglass is centered vertically and horizontally, occupying approximately 70% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright bottom bulb of the hourglass containing the running figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top bold text, follow the circular text path down to the running figures, then back up through the hourglass neck.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark purple textured area surrounding the central hourglass and text circle.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale Sand and Sky Blue (interior hourglass scene)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white/sand interior and the low-value purple exterior; muted saturation overall to mimic vintage print.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to purple, white, sand, and muted teal

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and wide sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Blocky, high-impact slab serifs for main titles
Uniform stroke weight for circular secondary text
Tight letter spacing in the top headers
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand is stylized and smaller than adjacent letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold slab serif for impact paired with a clean, light sans-serif for decorative framing.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif aesthetic of the 1960s
Similar wide, sturdy feel for secondary headers

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a textured deep purple background with a heavy dark vignette. In the center, place an hourglass silhouette. The top bulb should be translucent teal glass. The bottom bulb should contain a bright, sun-drenched sandy landscape with four small silhouetted figures running across it.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold white slab-serif text at the top. Add a secondary circle of white sans-serif text that perfectly frames the hourglass silhouette.

verificationChecks: Is the text at the top bold and slab-serif?
Does the text form a perfect circle around the hourglass?
Is the background a textured purple with a vignette?
Are there figures running inside the bottom of the hourglass?

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of the landscape into the hourglass

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hourglass neck is narrow and centered
Check that circular text does not overlap the hourglass
Verify the purple background has a 'dusty' or 'paper' texture
Confirm the figures are in silhouette against the bright sand
recipe.reuseFormula: Hourglass silhouette + [Landscape Scene] inside + [Textured Color] background + Circular [Sans-Serif] text frame + Bold [Slab Serif] header.
